title: 49 ### 3.4 Persons arrested under Local & Special Laws A total of 3061889 persons were arrested during 1978 for committing various offences under local & special laws against the figures of 2826118 during 1977. Thus an increase was recorded in the number of arrests by 8·3 per cent in 1978 over 1977. The highest number of persons booked were (709584) under the offence 'Motor Vehicles Act' the percentage being 23·2 to total. The other offences accounted for 21·4 percent under 'prohibition Act' and 12·9 percent under 'Gambling Act'. The pattern of arrests under different offences was more or less, the same as was recorded during 1977. The relevant statistics are presented in Table—23 and 24.
